name: product-ui
description: One Claude Code plugin for web interfaces that read as a real product: product-ui settles tokens and wording first, decides whether each user-visible string should exist, keeps every text at 14px or more (12px for a short Latin-only run), checks the output mechanically, and reviews the rendered screen independently.

plugins.name: product-ui
plugins.description: Builds web interfaces that read as a real product: design tokens and UI wording settled in tokens.json before any markup, a test for whether each user-visible string should exist, a text-size minimum of 14px or more (12px for a short Latin-only run) that a PostToolUse hook checks after every write and reports back to Claude, deterministic checks on the output, and an independent rendered review. Carries the rules for Japanese UI copy and a lookup of palettes, font pairings, styles, charts and per-stack rules.
